newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - McDonald's shares slip.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - McDonald's shares slip.

text.p: McDonald Corp's decision to scale back its $0.55-sandwich marketing campaign after disappointing sales weighed on the shares in U.S. pre-open activity on Wednesday, traders said.
Before the market opened, shares in the fast-food giant slipped 5/8 to 48, traders said.

Traders said McDonald's move to eliminate the $0.55 offer from lunch and dinner menus, but keep it for breakfast sandwiches, brought negative comments from analysts. Details were not immediately available.
Elsehwere, Great Western Financial Corp shares traded 3/8 lower to 47, after H.F. Ahmanson and Co said it withdrew a $6.73 billion hostile bid for the company.
Ahmanson's move clears the way for Washington Mutual Inc to proceed with its friendly $6.74 billion merger with Great Western.
Before the market opened, Washington Mutual shares weakened, giving up 3/4 to 53, while traders reported no move in Ahmanson's stock.
Ahmanson launched its Great Western bid in February.
Among other active shares, Intel Corp added one to 146, 3Com shed 7/16 to 45-1/2, Sun Microsystems rose to 33-3/8 from 32-1/2, and Dell Computer added 3/8 to 108-1/2.
